description: Use for site facts, not a fix list. Set view: health (0-100 score, four penalties), status (recent runs, changes, priorities, GSC archive), worklog (previous rounds; limit/offset), profile (business model, offers, audiences, markets, revenue pages), crawler_gaps (AI crawler paths that 404 or are blocked), asn (traffic by network, tiered evidence), asn_detail (one ASN's 7/30/90-day history; asn), cms (platform, connection capabilities and write path: agent-apply/proposal-only/reconnect-required/code-or-manual). Findings: get_audit. Ranked fixes: get_opportunities. One page: get_evidence or get_page_report.

historyDays.description: History window for daily rows, top paths and UA pool; the tier is always judged on yesterday + today

radarDays.description: Only radar updates published within this many days

view.description: Which read to run; see the tool description for each view.
